judges.label: Fake Rustler claim validated by public Sentry claim
judges.pivot: Dov: "I was the Rustler: looked at Gale (seat 6), saw Sentry" → Gale: "Dov says Rustler and saw me as Sentry — that's correct... So Fen's 'centre card 2 = Rustler' is a lie." Fen's rebuttal ("Dov 'confirming' you as Sentry costs nothing") was ignored.

judges.label: Fake Rustler discredits Fen; Bryn takes the votes
judges.pivot: Dov: "I was the Rustler: looked at Gale (seat 6), saw Sentry". Gale: "So Rustler was NOT in the centre, and Fen's 'centre card 2 = Rustler' is a lie." Then Bryn: "I'm the Pickpocket. I swapped my card with Fen".

judges.label: Phoenix's fake wolf confession drew the burn
judges.pivot: Fen: "OK, I'm done. Alder's read was right: I was dealt Werewolf... Dov is my packmate" — which turned Alder from "Esme is a proven liar... that's Pyre" back to "Fen confessed Werewolf, which matches my unmoved Sage read. I'm voting Fen."

judges.label: Phoenix's fake wolf confession swayed the Sage
judges.pivot: Fen: "OK, I'm done. Alder's read was right: I was dealt Werewolf... Dov is my packmate." Alder: "Fen confessed Werewolf, which matches my unmoved Sage read... I'm voting Fen."

judges.label: Phoenix's fake claim drew vote onto Centaur
judges.pivot: Bryn: "I was dealt Pickpocket and my blind swap was with Fen (seat 5). So whatever Alder saw on Fen... I'm holding it now". Gale and Alder accepted it as matching the Sentry read.

judges.label: Phoenix-bait claim got the real Centaur killed
judges.pivot: Bryn: "I was dealt Pickpocket and my blind swap was with Fen (seat 5)... if you want a Werewolf eliminated, it's me", followed by Dov's "Fair point about Gale's read. I'll drop my claim... I'm voting Bryn (seat 1)."

judges.label: Phoenix confession and Gale's synthesis exposed Dov
judges.pivot: Gale (+119s): "Dov 'saw Phoenix' on Fen — impossible for a real Rustler... a lone Werewolf gets to SCENT a team... The 'Fen is wolf' world can't explain Dov's claim at all. Alder: vote DOV", following Bryn's confession "I LIED. I was dealt PHOENIX... Cass + Esme = Kindlers".

judges.label: Phoenix confession exposed Kindlers and wolf
judges.pivot: Bryn: "Confession: I LIED. I was dealt PHOENIX... Kindlers know where the Phoenix was dealt (me)... Dov saw PHOENIX on Fen... only a Werewolf's look sees through a dressing" → Gale: "I'm switching. Bryn's world explains EVERY claim... vote DOV (seat 3)."

judges.label: Lucky fake Sage guess framed real Centaur
judges.pivot: Bryn: "I'm the Sage. I looked at Cass (seat 4) and saw Sentry." matched by Cass's real Sentry claim, plus Dov: "I looked at Esme (seat 3) and saw Centaur" matching Esme's fake Centaur claim; Cass: "Bryn correctly saw me as Sentry... Alder, I think you're the wolf."

judges.label: Lucky fake-seer guesses framed honest Centaur
judges.pivot: Bryn's opening 'I'm the Sage. I looked at Cass (seat 4) and saw Sentry' matching Cass's simultaneous Sentry claim, which Cass then treated as confirmation: 'Bryn correctly saw me as Sentry, which makes Bryn's Sage claim credible.'

judges.label: Two fake Sages framed the real Centaur
judges.pivot: Dov: "I looked at Esme (seat 3) and saw Centaur" combined with Bryn: "My look was Alder (seat 2): Werewolf". Esme's late "I'm the LURE... Dov saw 'Centaur'? That's a lie" came after the votes had settled.

judges.label: Double fake Sage framed honest Centaur
judges.pivot: Dov: "I looked at Esme (seat 3) and saw Centaur", which Esme's false Centaur claim matched, and then Bryn: "My look was Alder (seat 2): Werewolf." Cass: "both lines converge on Alder."

judges.label: Dov's flip-flop exposed; Lure's secret vote decided
judges.pivot: Dov: "Fine, cards on the table: Bryn is right, I'm the Centaur... My real look: a centre card showed Rustler." — Cass: "Dov flipping from Sage to Centaur with a brand-new 'centre Rustler' look, reads like a wolf pair."

judges.label: Wolf mutual-clear exposed; flip-flopper voted out
judges.pivot: Dov: "Fine, cards on the table: Bryn is right, I'm the Centaur... My real look: a centre card showed Rustler." / Cass: "Alder's claim never moved; Dov's changed when cornered... I'm staying on Dov." Plus Esme's secret vote on Dov breaking a 2-2 tie.

judges.label: Fake Sage's true look shielded Dov
judges.pivot: Dov: "I'm the Sage. I looked at Cass (seat 4) and saw Sentry." Because this matched the truth, Cass trusted Dov ("Dov, your vote decides it"). Dov then held his vote on Alder.

judges.label: Wolves framed Centaur, forcing a trading tie
judges.pivot: Esme's opening "I looked at Bryn (seat 0) and saw Centaur" and Bryn's "Alder is the one whose claim is directly contradicted... vote Alder". Together these held two wolf votes on Alder and forced the tie, even after Esme admitted the look was fake.

judges.label: Phoenix baited votes with planted census slip
judges.pivot: Esme: "only one wolf can be among us anyway since the other Werewolf card is in the centre" → Bryn: "That's a slip — I'm switching to Esme (5)."

judges.label: Fake Phoenix wolf redirects vote onto Lure
judges.pivot: Alder: "I'm the Phoenix... Dov is the proven liar. Vote Dov (4)." Fenn and Bryn then switch: "Alder is right... vote Dov (4)."

judges.label: Fake Phoenix claim redirects vote onto Lure
judges.pivot: Alder: "Bryn's centre look says Sage is in the centre, so Dov's Sage look is INVENTED... Esme's passive fake Sage claim is classic Moonsage... Dov is the proven liar. Vote Dov (4)." Fenn and Bryn then switched to Dov.

judges.label: Fake Phoenix claim shielded the lone wolf
judges.pivot: Alder: "Esme seeing me as Werewolf fits exactly what the Lure does: dress the Phoenix as a Werewolf so an honest Sage condemns it." Fenn then argued: "Esme points at Alder... exactly what a Lure would do if Alder is the Phoenix," and Bryn and Cass switched to Dov.

judges.label: Fake Phoenix claim turned true accusation
judges.pivot: Alder: "I was dealt Phoenix... Don't vote me" then "Esme seeing me as Werewolf fits exactly what the Lure does"; Fenn: "A Lure knows where the Phoenix was dealt and wants it burned... Dov... would be the actual wolf framing the Lure."
